=IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("IFERROR(
  LET(
    _brut, A2,
    _lignes, SPLIT(_brut, CHAR(10), FALSE),
    _1ere_brute, INDEX(_lignes, 1, 1),
    
    IF(LEFT(_1ere_brute, 11) = ""Vêtement : "",
      HSTACK(
        SUBSTITUTE(_1ere_brute, ""Vêtement : "", """"), 
        """", 
  "&"      IFERROR(FILTER(TRANSPOSE(_lignes), REGEXMATCH(TRANSPOSE(_lignes), ""^Vêtement$"")), """"),
        MAKEARRAY(1, 11, LAMBDA(r, c, """"))
      ),
      HSTACK(
        {
          _1ere_brute , 
          IFERROR(INDEX(SPLIT(INDEX(_lignes, 1, 2), "":"&" "", FALSE), 1, 2), """") , 
          IFERROR(INDEX(SPLIT(INDEX(_lignes, 1, 3), "": "", FALSE), 1, 2), """") , 
          IFERROR(INDEX(SPLIT(INDEX(_lignes, 1, 4), "": "", FALSE), 1, 2), """") , 
          IFERROR(INDEX(SPLIT(INDEX(_lignes, 1, 5), "": """&", FALSE), 1, 2), """") , 
          IFERROR(INDEX(_lignes, 1, 6), """") , 
          IFERROR(INDEX(_lignes, 1, 7), """")
        },
        MAKEARRAY(1, 6, LAMBDA(r, c, TRUE))
      )
    )
  ), 
  """"
)"),"Armure de Peau complet")
